About: Immutable snapshots of public photon-interaction data and their provenance; extraction date 2026-10-04 (read-only HTTP GET).

Archives.Note: xcom/ files are XCOM/MDATX3.zzz and XCOM/ATWTS.DAT extracted unchanged from this archive (the archive is not committed).

Citations.Xcom: M. J. Berger, J. H. Hubbell, S. M. Seltzer, J. Chang, J. S. Coursey, R. Sukumar, D. S. Zucker and K. Olsen, XCOM: Photon Cross Sections Database, NIST Standard Reference Database 8 (XGAM), https://physics.nist.gov/xcom ; element data files from https://physics.nist.gov/PhysRefData/Xcom/XCOM.tar.gz
Citations.AirMuEn: J. H. Hubbell and S. M. Seltzer, Tables of X-Ray Mass Attenuation Coefficients and Mass Energy-Absorption Coefficients, NISTIR 5632 (1995), dry air: https://physics.nist.gov/PhysRefData/XrayMassCoef/ComTab/air.html
Citations.AirComposition: NIST ESTAR material 104, Air, dry (near sea level): density 1.20479E-03 g/cm3, mass fractions C 0.000124, N 0.755267, O 0.231781, Ar 0.012827; https://physics.nist.gov/cgi-bin/Star/compos.pl?matno=104 (tab2.html lists the same material rounded: 1.205E-03 g/cm3, N 0.755268).
Citations.Soil: H. L. Beck, J. DeCampo and C. Gogolak, In Situ Ge(Li) and NaI(Tl) Gamma-Ray Spectrometry, USAEC Health and Safety Laboratory report HASL-258 (1972): Table 2 soil composition by weight Al2O3 13.5 %, Fe2O3 4.5 %, SiO2 67.5 %, CO2 4.5 %, H2O 10 % (HASL-258 p. 44); soil density 1.6 g/cm3 (p. 10).
